name: Sesame Crusted Cod with Green Bean-Bell Pepper Sauté & Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg green beans
3 yellow bell peppers
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Trim green beans, place in a large bowl, and set aside.
Pat the cod dry with paper towels and place on a large plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg cod fillet
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs and cornstarch in a medium bowl; beat with a whisk or fork until smooth.
Place sesame seeds on another plate. Dip cod in the egg mixture, then dredge in the sesame seeds, pressing gently to adhere; return to the plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add cod and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips; add to the bowl with the green beans.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the bowl.

Preheat a large pot over medium heat. When the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 7-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice between plates or bowls; top with cod and veggies. Enjoy!
